rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the pound as a unit of weight, including the standard 16-ounce pound.

example.english: I bought a pound of rice.
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 jat1 bong6 mai5

rows.note: Use this as the default for striking something hard and repeatedly.

example.english: They use a hammer to pound the wooden board.
example.jyutping: keoi5 jung6 ceoi4 zai2 maang5 daa2 faai3 muk6 baan2

rows.note: Use this when a heart or pulse is beating strongly or throb­bing.

example.english: I can feel my heart pound when I get on stage.
example.traditional: 我一上台，個心就怦怦跳。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jat1 soeng5 toi4 go3 sam1 zau6 paang1 paang1 tiu3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the British currency rather than the weight unit or other pound currencies.

example.english: One pound is currently worth about ten Hong Kong dollars.
example.traditional: 一英鎊而家大約值十蚊港紙。
example.jyutping: jat1 jing1 bong6 ji4 gaa1 daai6 joek3 zik6 sap6 man1 gong2 zi2

rows.note: Use this when pounding something until it is crushed into small pieces or powder.

example.english: You need to pound the garlic until it is crushed, then add it to the wok.
example.traditional: 你要將蒜頭搗碎先落鑊。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 zoeng1 syun3 tau4 dou2 seoi3 sin1 lok6 wok6

rows.note: Use this when someone walks with noticeably heavy footfalls.

example.english: They pound along so heavily that even the people downstairs can hear them.
example.traditional: 佢行路好重，樓下都聽到。
example.jyutping: keoi5 haang4 lou6 hou2 cung5 lau4 haa6 dou1 teng1 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a forceful blow, especially in descriptions of a fight or impact.

example.english: The boxer landed a hard pound, knocking his opponent to the ground.
example.traditional: 拳手使出一記重擊，將對手打到倒地。
example.jyutping: kyun4 sau2 sai2 ceot1 jat1 gei3 cung5 gik1 zoeng1 deoi3 sau2 daa2 dou3 dou2 dei6

rows.note: Use this after a country name for a non-British pound currency, such as 埃及鎊 or 黎巴嫩鎊.

example.english: One Egyptian pound can't currently be exchanged for one Hong Kong dollar.
example.traditional: 一埃及鎊而家兌唔到一蚊港紙。
example.jyutping: jat1 aai1 kap6 bong6 ji4 gaa1 deoi3 m4 dou2 jat1 man1 gong2 zi2
